title: Axon canonical-node connection
description: The app-private connection contract for a device joining one Axon deployment. The node may be a Mac, a home server or a hosted node; a paired device key, not the network, admits the device (PRD Q119).

node_id.description: Stable identity of this canonical node. It survives URL changes and migration.

canonical_base_url.description: The node's main address: any HTTPS origin (a tailnet name, a hosted node or an own server), checked against the platform's roots, or desktop loopback during development. Null when the device only uses the local network.

local.description: The node's local-network listener (libs/sjel-server/src/lan.rs). Tried before canonical_base_url with a short connect timeout.

pin_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the node's self-signed certificate. The only certificate this device accepts at base_url.
